sloka: राक्षसान्समरे दुष्टान्सानुबन्धान्मदोद्धतान् ।नुदं त्वं नो भयं देव नीहारमिव भास्करः ।। ७.६.१८ ॥
transliteration: rākṣasānsamare duṣṭānsānubandhānmadoddhatān ।nudaṁ tvaṁ no bhayaṁ deva nīhāramiva bhāskaraḥ ।। 7.6.18 ॥

translations.english: Offer to Yama those whose lotus-like faces are severed by your discus, for there is no other giver of fearlessness to us in times of fear except you.
